items.t: 2027 increases announced on a similar calendar to 2026
items.body: UPS announced its 2027 increase on 2026-10-23, effective Dec. 21, 2026. Its 2026 increase was announced 2025-10-31 and took effect Dec. 22, 2025. FedEx announced on 2026-09-18, effective Jan. 4, 2027; its 2026 increase was announced 2025-09-12, effective Jan. 5, 2026, and its 2018 increase was announced 2017-09-18, effective Jan. 1, 2018. UPS's 2019 increase was announced 2018-12-05 for Dec. 26, 2018, about 3 weeks' notice, and an analysis says the Dec. 21 date puts 11 days of 2027 rates into 2026 budgets.

items.t: Average increase holds at 5.9%; surcharges rise faster
items.body: UPS and FedEx both list a 5.9% average for 2027, the same headline as 2024, 2025 and 2026; 2023 was 6.9% and 2018 was 4.9%. An analysis says all 20 of the most common UPS surcharges rise more than 5.9%, averaging 9.1%, and UPS's Ground residential charge goes to $7.10 from $6.50 after $6.10 to $6.50 in the 2026 increase. FedEx's residential delivery charge goes from $6.95 to $7.35 (service not specified in the source).

items.t: New kinds of charges appear in the 2027 round
items.body: UPS adds an origin-ZIP surcharge on Ground and Ground Saver for Qualified customers, effective Dec. 21, 2026 or later, with no amount published, and a 5% fuel surcharge on Small Business Rates. UPS's Additional Handling minimum billable weight rises from 40 lb to 50 lb; the 40 lb minimum came with the 2025 increase. FedEx adds a $25 paper trade document fee and a $5 manual airbill fee on Jan. 18, 2027, and USPS plans a weekly fuel surcharge from January 2027, where in 2021 USPS noted it had no fuel surcharge.

items.t: Off-cycle changes: USPS mid-year moves and UPS fuel tables
items.body: USPS added a temporary 8% on parcel base postage effective Apr. 26, 2026 (announced 2026-03-25) through Jan. 17, 2027, and removed Ground Advantage Commercial ounce tiers on July 12, 2026 (+11.8% average). Earlier mid-year USPS changes were Parcel Select +25% in July 2024 and Ground Advantage about +7.1% in July 2025. UPS changed domestic fuel tables on Jan. 5, Mar. 9 (its third increase of 2026), Aug. 10 and Nov. 2, 2026, and the Nov. 2 Ground table charges 0.50 point more than the old one at the same diesel price.

items.t: 2026 peak charges above 2025 levels at FedEx, UPS and USPS
items.body: FedEx's Nov. 23 - Dec. 27, 2026 window sets Ground residential at $0.80 (2025: $0.65), Additional Handling at $11.85 (2025: $10.90) and Ground Economy at $4.05 (2025: $3.55). UPS Large Package peak is $117.50 against $107 in 2025, and Over Maximum Limits is $590 against $540. USPS's 2026 peak was announced 2026-08-25 and stacks on the temporary 8%, with retail Priority Mail and Ground Advantage Zones 1-4, 0-3 lb at +$0.50, against +$0.40 in 2025 and +$0.30 in 2024; in 2018 FedEx charged no residential peak surcharge.

items.t: New in 2026: cubic-size triggers, DIM change, per-pound fees
items.body: FedEx (Jan. 12) and UPS (Jan. 26) moved Additional Handling to a cubic-size trigger of more than 10,368 cubic inches; UPS also made Large Package apply above 17,280 cubic inches or 110 lb. USPS cut its dimensional-weight divisor from 166 to 139 on July 12, 2026, after its 2019 cut from 194 to 166. UPS added per-pound surge fees on U.S.-Middle East shipments on Mar. 22, 2026 ($1.34/lb), and FedEx added a Vietnam-to-U.S. fee of $0.36 per lb. for priority-class services effective Nov. 2, 2026.
